text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin is convinced that her<n>sisters' dream is
to dance—until the<n>day of the Arima Kinen, that is.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her sisters scold her for deciding<n>their dreams for
them, and insist that<n>what they really want is for her
to<n>keep racing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just Ines's sisters who<n>feel this
way—her coworkers from her<n>part-time jobs are
just as captivated<n>by her running.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When she runs, Ines is doing more<n>than simply
satisfying her own<n>desire—she's giving countless
people<n>hope.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Realizing that it's okay for her to run<n>as much as
she wants, and to enjoy<n>it too, Ines wells up. It's
not long<n>before her cheeks are glistening with<n>warm
tears.
